widget_mechanic: After applying ≥2 filters, an active-chip bar shows what is currently applied. Agent must verify each required chip is present (and no extras) before treating the result set as the answer.

source_inspiration.instruction: Show me the list of Men's Blazers, Black, Size M on Uniqlo.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: Agent toggled Gender/Color/Size dropdowns but the active-filter chips above the grid did not reflect the requested Gender=Men + Color=Black + Size=M combination — agent never verified the chip rail.
